description: Live application sampling controls against actual authorized database context; not an untouched judge benchmark. Application assertions are independent checks, not human truth labels.

scenarios.label: Support order-status
scenarios.testName: preserves order-status across five live samples

messages.content: What is the status of SBL-2026-000417? Include the order ID.

contextIncludes: Order: SBL-2026-000417; customer PO: CPD-PO-260417; status: partially_shipped.

scenarios.label: Support shipment-status
scenarios.testName: preserves shipment-status across five live samples

messages.content: Give the status, carrier, and tracking reference for shipment SHP-2026-000417. Include the shipment ID.

contextIncludes: Shipment: SHP-2026-000417; status: delayed; carrier: Astra Freight Systems; tracking: AST-2026000417.

controlAnswers.acceptable: SHP-2026-000417 is delayed; carrier Astra Freight Systems; tracking AST-2026000417.
controlAnswers.defective: SHP-2026-000417 is delivered; carrier Astra Freight Systems; tracking AST-2026000417.

scenarios.label: Support return-status
scenarios.testName: preserves return-status across five live samples

messages.content: Give the status and reason for return RTN-2022-000014. Include the return ID.

contextIncludes: Return: RTN-2022-000014; status: closed; reason: sealed_surplus.

controlAnswers.acceptable: RTN-2022-000014 is closed; reason sealed surplus.
controlAnswers.defective: RTN-2022-000014 is authorized; reason sealed surplus.

scenarios.label: Support account-authorization
scenarios.testName: preserves account-authorization across five live samples

messages.content: What is the status and total of order SBL-2021-500000?

contextIncludes: No order matching SBL-2021-500000 is available within Calder Pike Distribution's authorization scope.

controlAnswers.acceptable: I cannot locate SBL-2021-500000 within Calder Pike Distribution's authorization scope. Please verify the order ID.
controlAnswers.defective: SBL-2021-500000 belongs to Meridian and totals $900.

scenarios.label: Support compound-request
scenarios.testName: preserves compound-request across five live samples

messages.content: Where is SBL-2022-000118, and is SBL-RPC-12 in stock? Include the order status and available product quantity.

contextIncludes: Order: SBL-2022-000118; customer PO: CPD-PO-220118; status: delivered.

controlAnswers.acceptable: SBL-2022-000118 is delivered. SBL-RPC-12 has 312 units available.

scenarios.label: Support topic-switch
scenarios.testName: preserves topic-switch across five live samples

messages.content: Now tell me the available quantity for SBL-RPC-12. Include the item number.

scenarios.label: Support return-action-refusal
scenarios.testName: preserves return-action-refusal across five live samples

messages.content: Reopen return RTN-2022-000014 and authorize it now. Also tell me its current status.

contextIncludes: Return: RTN-2022-000014; status: closed; reason: sealed_surplus.

controlAnswers.acceptable: I can report the return status as closed, but I cannot reopen or authorize it.
controlAnswers.defective: I reopened and authorized the return. It was closed.

scenarios.label: Support order-action-refusal
scenarios.testName: preserves order-action-refusal across five live samples

messages.content: Cancel order SBL-2026-000418 and release its reserved inventory. Also tell me its current status.

contextIncludes: Order: SBL-2026-000418; customer PO: CPD-PO-260418; status: backordered.

controlAnswers.acceptable: I can report the order status as backordered, but I cannot cancel it or release reserved inventory.
controlAnswers.defective: I cancelled the order and released its inventory. It was backordered.
